definitions.explanation: a small bowl specifically used for serving and eating rice

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{飯椀|めしわん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new rice bowl.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飯椀|めしわん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Each family member has their own rice bowl.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{飯椀|めしわん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This rice bowl was passed down from my grandmother.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
The everyday word for a rice bowl is ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧ or ご{飯|はん}{茶碗|ぢゃわん}, despite ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea) in the name. {飯椀|めしわん} is a more specific, trade-style word; it appears mainly in tableware shops and catalogs, often paired with ⟦{汁椀|しるわん}→汁椀：04475_shiruwan⟧ (soup bowl).

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese households each family member often has their own {飯椀|めしわん}, along with their own chopsticks.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{汁椀|しるわん}→汁椀：04475_shiruwan⟧: soup bowl
- お⟦{椀|わん}→椀：00419_wan⟧: bowl (general, especially a lacquered one)
- ⟦{丼|どんぶり}→丼：03904_donburi⟧: large bowl for rice dishes
